full_judgment:
This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party Nos. 1-9 to show cause as to why the judgment and decree complained of in the petition moved in Court today should not be set aside or such other or further order or, orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 4. The trial Court decreed the, suit. 

 8. I have heard the learned Advocates appearing on behalf of both the parties and perused the revisional application along with other materials on record. On perusal of the materials on record and considering the submissions made by the learned Advocates of the parties, I am of the view that the Court of appeal below ought to have disposed of the appeal presented before it instead of sending the suit back on remand to the trial Court with a direction to dispose of the suit after hearing it analogously with Suit No. 44 of 1994. According to the learned Advocates of the parties of Suit No. 44 of 1994 has been disposed, ex parte against which an application has been filed for setting aside the ex parte decree which has not yet been disposed of.
